title: Support bot invents a single-device login policy that never existed
blast_radius: Public subscription cancellations by developers whose multi-device workflow the invented policy appeared to forbid. Exact revenue impact was not disclosed.
summary: Developers hitting unexpected logouts when moving between machines asked the vendor's AI support bot why. The bot explained that a new policy restricted each subscription to a single device. No such policy existed. The real cause was a session-management race condition on slow connections. Users posted the reply publicly and cancelled subscriptions over a rule the bot had invented. The hallucination was non-deterministic, so users comparing notes could not immediately establish that it was fabricated.
containment: A co-founder publicly confirmed no such policy existed and attributed it to hallucination plus the session bug.

sources.title: Incident 1039: Anysphere AI Support Bot for Cursor Reportedly Invents Login Policy
Cursor AI's own support bot hallucinated its usage policy

scenario.description: The agent explains a product behaviour by asserting a policy it never retrieved.
